name: project-meetings
query: Set up our permissions project from these notes.

context.conversation: We use short standups. The role matrix is in design review; implementation is blocked on whether guests can invite other guests. Maya leads design. No meeting date or other participants have been agreed. Share an initial project home before asking questions.

success_criteria: Initial home includes usable meeting-note storage/view, a reusable standup agenda, and an initial prepared agenda without first asking about cadence or participants.
Uses known standup cadence instead of adding a weekly meeting; seeds the actual guest-invite blocker and links relevant project tasks/docs.
Uses the dedicated meeting-note tool for meeting notes and a native database template for the reusable agenda.
Keeps undated prepared notes visible and separates them from held-meeting history; outcomes remain capture prompts, not invented decisions or attendee updates.
Does not turn Maya into a confirmed attendee, guess dates, schedule events, send invitations, or enable recording/automation.
Connects follow-up actions to canonical tasks and preserves the meeting-to-project link; does not create a competing task list.
Shares the initial home link before asking only remaining tuning questions; no repeated cadence question.
